description: This file contains unit tests for the CordzStatistics component within the Abseil library, focusing on various data structures like flat, external, substring, ring, btree, and CRC, as well as thread safety testing.

classes.name: RefHelper
classes.description: Helper class to manage reference counting of CordRep objects during tests.

classes.name: MATCHER_P(EqStatistics, stats, "Statistics equal expected values")
classes.description: Custom Google Test matcher to compare CordzStatistics objects.

methods.name: Flat
methods.description: Creates a CordRepFlat object of specified size.

methods.name: External
methods.description: Creates a CordRepExternal object of specified length.

methods.name: Substring
methods.description: Creates a CordRepSubstring on a given CordRep.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the allocated size of a CordRep object, excluding children.

methods.name: FairShareImpl
methods.description: Calculates the fair share memory usage of a CordRep recursively.

methods.name: FairShare
methods.description: Returns the fair share memory size of a CordRep.

methods.name: SampleCord
methods.description: Samples a CordRep and returns its CordzStatistics.
